mapper.select: SELECT ww.word_id AS wordId, ww.sequence_no AS sequenceNo FROM wordbook_word ww INNER JOIN word w ON w.id = ww.word_id AND w.deleted = 0 WHERE ww.deleted = 0 AND ww.enabled = 1 AND ww.wordbook_id = #{wordbookId} AND ww.sequence_no > #{startSequenceNo} ORDER BY ww.sequence_no ASC, ww.word_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
